EPA - Cooperator Name - CRADA # Date Last Saved: July 2, 2024

STATEMENT OF WORK

For

COOPERATIVE RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT

Between

The United States Environmental Protection Agency

[Name of EPA Laboratory or Office]

And

[Name of the Company]

Title of Project

Goal

Briefly describe what is expected to be accomplished under the CRADA. Please clearly state the nature of the research and development that you are undertaking and how these activities are consistent with the lab's mission.

Approach

Describe how the goal will be accomplished. This includes the list of tasks to be completed, what EPA will do for each task and what the cooperator will do for each task. In addition, if a quality assurance plan is necessary, include that information. The following is an example for a CRADA designed to develop field measurement techniques:

Task 1: Field Testing (or R&D, modeling, etc., as appropriate)

Description of the type of testing that will be done, what will be measured, what will be done with the data.

Laboratory Responsibilities:

Cooperator Responsibilities:

Task 2: Data Analysis

Description of what types of analyses will be done.

Laboratory Responsibilities:

Cooperator Responsibilities:

Task 3: Presentation of Results

Describe how and where results will be presented (e.g., at a workshop).

Laboratory Responsibilities:

Cooperator Responsibilities:

Resources

Describe EPA's and the Cooperator's contributions, both non-monetary and monetary. For example:

Laboratory

The Laboratory will contribute technical assistance*,* logistical support and environmental sampling and analysis. This will include use of EPA facilities, supplies, field work/sampling, and costs associated with their travel.

Estimated total in-kind contributions $

Cooperator

The Cooperator will provide technical assistance, workshop oversight, data analyses and supporting research (including use of facilities, personnel and supplies), as needed.

Estimated total in-kind contributions $

Estimated total cash contribution (if any) $

End Products

Identify specific end products and the timeline for completion. This includes the number of days or months for each task from date of final approval of the Agreement.

For example:

Months 1 - 7 Task 1

Months 8 - 10 Task 2

Month 11 Task 3

Months 12 - 15 Preparation of and presentation of data at EPA workshop

Months 19 - 24 Distribution of the EPA workshop products
